headline: KIMS expands Saveera Hospital in Anantapur to 500 beds

The upgraded facility now features a new Oncology Block for advanced cancer care and a dedicated Mother and Child Block equipped with neonatal intensive care units. This expansion increases the healthcare group's operational footprint in the region. Retail investors in hospital stocks track regional capacity additions for revenue growth indicators.
